title: Artificial Intelligence, Lean Startup Method, and Product Innovations
eligible_reason: Figure 3 (first row) reports Callaway-Sant'Anna event-study estimates (csdid, window -2..2) of a binary AI-adoption indicator (ai_treat = general_AI > -0.9) that switches on at firm-specific years (cohorts 2013-2020 among 947 switchers), with firm and year dimensions and no covariates, for two outcomes (software copyrights, trademarks) and two samples (low-LSM firms, all firms). Under PROTOCOL Section 2 a reported CSA estimate of a staggered binary design is eligible and the TWFE counterpart can be constructed. Caveats: the binary treatment is a threshold on a continuous index; 101 switchers revert below the threshold (drop post-adoption zeros); only 9 firms are never treated, so the never-treated control group is very thin (one panel uses not-yet-treated controls); 731 firms are treated in all observed years and are dropped by csdid.
design_notes: Panel of 1,687 Chinese startups, 2012-2020 (10,641 firm-years, unbalanced), Crunchbase/Tianyancha-derived. Main tables (3-7) are areg/xtreg/xtivreg2 regressions of lead innovation counts on continuous AI and LSM indices with time-varying controls (age, employees, hires, patents, copyrights, approvals, funding) and year FE, instrumenting AI with provincial AI-policy counts and industry AI news. Figure 3 first row: csdid lead_total_sw / lead_total_tm, ivar(newid) time(year) gvar(gvar), subsamples has_lsm==0 and all firms; one panel with notyet. The .dta already contains ai_treat, gvar and has_lsm columns. AI_Lean_code.txt notes results may differ within 5% across Stata versions.
main_or_robustness: robustness (Figure 3 event-study evidence supporting the main continuous-treatment regressions)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: first ai_treat year among switchers (excluding firms treated from their first observed year): 2013:95, 2014:158, 2015:174, 2016:199, 2017:658, 2018:330, 2019:4, 2020:5 (counts include firms whose first observed year is the first treated year; recompute after dropping always-treated)
never_treated_note: only 9 firms never cross the threshold

specs.treatment_definition: ai_treat = 1 if the firm's standardized AI-capability index general_AI > -0.9 (binarized AI adoption); gvar = first year with ai_treat==1 (0 for never-adopters); 731 firms are treated in every observed year, 947 switch on, 101 of the switchers later fall back below the threshold (non-absorbing; drop post-adoption zeros per protocol); 9 never-treated firms
specs.fe: csdid: unit and year (cohort-by-period ATT(g,t) aggregated to event time, window(-2,2))
specs.data_file: AI Lean Replication Data and Code (need zip)/AI_Lean_data.dta

specs.notes: Reported as csdid_estat event, window(-2,2) plots (coefficients not tabulated in the package). Only 9 never-treated firms: CSA with never-treated controls rests on a tiny comparison group; TWFE counterpart would be reghdfe outcome ai_treat, absorb(newid year).

screener_notes: Eligible via the CSA figure only; the headline results are continuous-treatment IV regressions.
